description: List a company's investor events, newest first: earnings calls plus conferences, investor days and shareholder meetings. Each row gives the event id, type, UTC start, title, fiscal period (earnings calls only), status, and each material's status (available, pending, notPublished, failed, notAttempted, noCallHeld) for transcript, audio and slides. Read a conference by event id with GetInvestorEventTranscript; GetEarningsCallEvent is keyed by fiscal quarter.

eventType.description: Optional event type to filter on: EarningsCall, CapitalMarketsDay, InvestorUpdate, AGM, Conference, FiresideChat, or MAndA (default: all types)

includeUncaptured.description: Also list events hidden because none of their materials could be captured and still on the company's own IR calendar (default false); their status reads Unavailable.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 25, max 100; values outside 1-100 are clamped)

offset.description: Number of matching events to skip before returning rows (default 0)

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:AIR) for a listing outside the US.

name: ListInvestorEvents
title: Browse Investor Events
